Title: Vinod and the Family

Cast

1. Vinod - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Neeta - 26 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Ajay - 31 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Sunita - 62 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree

Scene 1: The fields - Day

[Vinod stands in the fields. Sunita and Neeta stand near him.]

Neeta: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod ploughs the field.]

Vinod: "One more time!"

[Vinod harvests the wheat with a sickle.]

Vinod: "How beautiful!"

[Vinod rests under the tree in the shade.]

Vinod: "I really enjoyed today."
